lines: The stew's near ready. Won't be long now.
A cup of mead for you? Sweet as summer honey, that is.
What's your pleasure then? Ale, mead, or cider?
You'll find no better ale in all of Dunland!
Try our mead! It puts that filthy Rohan stuff to shame.
No trouble in my hall, mind. Eat, drink, and be welcome.
Welcome! Welcome to my roundhouse!
No Strawheads allowed in here!
I'll give you a good meal or a drink for just a few silver coins.
You looking for a drink?
This roundhouse may be filthy, but the grub's second to none!
Got any silver coins?
Our ale is the finest ale in all the lands!
Thirsty? Our ale will satisfy all your needs! Ha! Ha!
For a few silver coins you can get your hands on the finest drink in Middle-earth!
Haven't seen you around before, not trying to stir up any trouble, are you?
Not from these parts, are you? What can I get for you?
Welcome stranger! You come to the best tavern with the finest ale in all of Dunland!
You aren't a friend of Rohan, are you?
What's your pleasure then, #p? Ale, mead, or cider?
You are among friends here, #p.
Welcome! Welcome to my roundhouse, #p!
Greetings, #p!
Welcome, #! What can I get for you today?
We Dunlendings like our drink, #p.
Welcome, #p! Enjoy your stay!
Want anything to eat or drink, #p? I just need some silver coins.
And here's #p! What can I do for you today?
Good day, what can I get for you?
Good day, what would you like today?
Good morning, what can I get for you?
Morning, what can I get for you?
Morning, what would you like todays?
Good morning, need some breakfast?
Good afternoon, what can I get for you?
Good afternoon, what would you like today?
We'll be getting ready for the afternoon feast here soon.
Good evening, what can I get for you?
Evening! What can I get for you?
Evening! What would you like?
Good evening. What'll you be having, then?
Come in, come in. No sense standing out in that weather.
It's quite the rainy day today, feel free to stay all you'd like.
Warm yourself by the fire while I draw your drink.
Come in out o' the rain, bach. There's room by the hearth.
Ha! Maybe you should hold off on the ale for a bit.
Be as drunk as you want, just don't brawl inside the tavern!
Does this trick, doesn't it?
Easy now, That ale's stronger than it tastes.
Get out of my tavern!
Friends of the Strawhats aren't welcome here!
You've taken enough of our land, you're not going to take my tavern!
No mead for you, scoundrel!
Get out of my hall!
Get out, you brigand!
I'll serve you nothing, I won't.
Leave now before I force you to!
What folly brought you here?
I'll not serve the likes of you, I won't!
No! No mead for you. Get out!
You will have nothing from me, servant of evil!
What madness drove you here?
You are not welcome here, #p!
